House of Wah Sun is one of my go-to Korean-Chinese restaurants in Chicago because it knows exactly what it is.

No frills. No reinvention. Just classic Korean-Chinese comfort food done right.

My order every time at House of Wah Sun

Jajangmyeon.
Jjamppong.
Tangsuyuk.

The jajangmyeon is rich and grounding. Thick noodles coated in deep, savory black bean sauce with just enough sweetness to keep you going back.

The jjamppong balances it out. Spicy, smoky seafood noodle soup with real wok hei that cuts through the richness and wakes everything back up.

That’s why this combo works. One anchors you. The other resets you. Back and forth until the bowls are empty.

Tangsuyuk on the side. Extra crispy. Sauce on the side because dipping is the move.

If you’re looking for a reliable Korean-Chinese restaurant in Chicago, especially for jajangmyeon and jjamppong, this belongs on your list.

📍 3234 W Irving Park Rd, Chicago, IL 60618

Save this for your next comfort-food night.

Jami Ul-Alfar, known locally as “the red mosque,” is a sight to behold. Outfitted with a distinctive red-and-white pattern, the mosque is one of Sri Lanka’s great architectural wonders, attracting worshippers and tourists alike. First commissioned in 1908, the structure was influenced by Indo-Saracenic architecture, a hybrid of Indian and Islamic styles. Today, the mosque has become the primary place of worship for Sri Lankan Muslims, capable of accommodating over 10,000 worshippers across its six floors.

Spicy Steak Pasta

Stealth Health Slow Cooker Meal Prep Series, Episode 6

Per serving (makes 10)
480 Calories
37g Protein
63g Carbs
9g Fat

Ingredients:
1 Shallot
8 cloves Garlic
28oz can fire roasted Tomatoes 
5 Guajillo Chile’s*
4 Chile de Arbol*
2 tsp soy sauce or fish sauce
60g honey (3 tablespoons)
1.5 Tablespoon salt
2 tsp onion powder
2 tsp paprika
2 tsp black pepper

*de-seeded & de-stemmed. For extra flavor development, toast on dry pan for 30-45 seconds or microwave for 15-20 seconds before adding to blender. If you prefer to not use dried chiles, replace with ~1 tablespoon of chili powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and some cayenne (not a perfect sub, but will get the job done)

32oz cubed flank steak 

High: 4-5 hours
Low: 5-6 hours 

300g plain nonfat Skyr (or Greek yogurt)
60g parmigiano reggiano
60g Goat cheese
240ml milk
Red chili flakes & chives 

672g Rigatoni (cooked to 50%, or half of time shown on box)

Cover & cook for 20-25 more minutes to finish cooking pasta 

Allocate to 10 equal sized containers - store in the freezer (they’ll last for several months frozen) - microwave for ~4 minutes to reheat. Add 2-3 tablespoons of milk when reheating for creamier sauce

Gully Boy (2019) dir. Zoya Akhtar

A pulsating coming of age drama set in the underground hip hop scene of Mumbai, Gully Boy traces the rise of a young dreamer from the margins to the mic. The film captures class struggle, ambition, and artistic hunger with emotional urgency and contemporary realism.

Ranveer Singh delivers a transformative performance as Murad, channeling vulnerability, rage, and quiet determination with striking authenticity. His chemistry with Alia Bhatt adds emotional grounding, making the journey feel intimate as well as aspirational.

With Zoya Akhtar’s dynamic storytelling and a groundbreaking soundtrack that brought Indian hip hop into the mainstream, Gully Boy became a cultural milestone in Hindi cinema. The film stands as a powerful statement on voice, identity, and the right to dream.

How to reduce stiffness in less then 5min:

Feeling stiff after an excessive day of sitting and you have no idea where to start?

This is a gamechanger

I do this almost every day.

1. Downward dog (30sec)
 -> Focus on length in you lower back, getting your hip  as high as possible, its also allowed to bent the knees here

2. Worlds Greatest Stretch
 -> try to go as deep with your elbow as you can, it doesn't have to touch the ground, then open up

3. Hip Flexor stretch (30sec)
 -> this is difficult I know, so you dont have to grab your toe here, in the beginning its enough to just stay in this Lunge

4. Runners stretch (30sec)
 -> this can be touch on the hamstrings but it will get better!

5. Pigeon Pose (30sec)
 -> also focus on length in your lower back and feel the stretch in your glutes

Then go back into the downward dog and repeat for the other leg.

You will end up needed around 5min for this.

First time doing it, your body will hate you, these stretches will feel brutal, but over time you will get used to it and you will feel the benefits.

Save this for later🤝

All best progress🤍
Lorenz
